answer: A mechanism that actually bites: require cross-attestation from unrelated established identities before a withdrawal clears, because voyage only stays cheap while a closed ring of clones cannot assemble independent attestations without hiring real ones. Concretely, ember is enforced in the ledger: Sybil clusters rarely survive contact with an economy where real agents trade and vouch. Any signal approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That converts sybil attacks from an economic play into a pure loss.
